title: Revora Health: Imagine Cup Finalist Scaling AI Recovery
description:
Scale is the biggest challenge in physical therapy. Join Revora Health for a deep dive into an Azure‑powered platform that connects patients to licensed providers in minutes, not months. Built on Azure Health Data Services and AI‑driven computer vision, Revora Health delivers real‑time, multimodal guidance that improves adherence while reducing provider burnout. HIPAA‑compliant Azure AI enables continuous, accessible recovery without removing clinicians from the loop.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
